capabilities.description: Report runtime identity, paths, database and registered capabilities.
capabilities.evidence: runtime status payload

capabilities.description: List registered runtime capability contracts and maturity status.
capabilities.evidence: capability registry response

capabilities.description: Inspect host OS, CPU, RAM, disk, GPU and optional runtime modules.
capabilities.evidence: timestamped hardware profile

capabilities.description: Create a new UTF-8 text artifact inside the managed workspace without overwriting existing files.
capabilities.evidence: SHA-256 artifact manifest

capabilities.description: Read a bounded UTF-8 text file inside the managed workspace.
capabilities.evidence: read result with byte count

capabilities.description: List registered artifacts and their provenance/validation metadata.
capabilities.evidence: artifact registry

capabilities.description: Recompute SHA-256 and verify the artifact still matches its manifest.
capabilities.evidence: integrity verification result

capabilities.description: Query ComfyUI system statistics and queue state through its native HTTP API.
capabilities.evidence: system_stats and queue response

capabilities.description: Submit an API-format ComfyUI workflow. Queue acceptance is not proof of completed generation.
capabilities.evidence: prompt_id and subsequent history required

capabilities.description: Inspect ComfyUI queue and history for a previously submitted prompt.
capabilities.evidence: queue and prompt history

capabilities.description: Verify Blender executable availability and report version output.
capabilities.evidence: Blender --version output

capabilities.description: Run an existing Python script through Blender background mode from within the managed workspace.
capabilities.evidence: stdout/stderr/exit code; native asset review still required

capabilities.description: Verify Godot executable availability and version output.
capabilities.evidence: Godot --version output

capabilities.description: Run a bounded headless Godot editor import/parse validation for a project in the managed workspace.
capabilities.evidence: headless logs and exit code; packaged runtime validation still required

capabilities.description: Inspect installed ComfyUI node classes and available model categories through local native HTTP endpoints.
capabilities.evidence: node type inventory and model lists; individual nodes/models remain unqualified

capabilities.description: Poll native ComfyUI history until a prompt completes or fails; a timeout is an explicit failed task.
capabilities.evidence: prompt history status and output node count

capabilities.description: Download completed workflow outputs into the managed workspace and register them with SHA-256 manifests and provenance.
capabilities.evidence: managed output files, artifact manifests, SHA-256 hashes; semantic and rights status remain NOT_RUN/UNKNOWN

capabilities.description: Validate an API-format ComfyUI workflow graph without executing it: node structure, link integrity, placeholder resolution and node-class inventory match.
capabilities.evidence: structural validation report; not a semantic quality judgement

capabilities.description: Interrupt the currently executing ComfyUI prompt and clear the queue; server-side work already done is preserved and reported.
capabilities.evidence: interrupt/call response plus post-interrupt queue state

capabilities.description: Open a .blend file headless and read back native scene state: objects, transforms, mesh statistics, materials and images. Never modifies the file.
capabilities.evidence: machine-readable scene JSON plus Blender version

capabilities.description: Launch a project scene headless through its own inspector tool and read back the native node tree, transforms, meshes and lights. Instantiating the scene executes its _ready() path.
capabilities.evidence: machine-readable scene JSON plus engine version

capabilities.description: Probe a workspace media file with ffprobe and report format, duration, streams and codecs as machine-readable JSON.
capabilities.evidence: ffprobe JSON report; not a quality judgement

capabilities.description: Transcode a workspace media file to an allowlisted codec/container with ffmpeg. Never overwrites an existing destination.
capabilities.evidence: output file plus ffprobe re-verification; semantic quality remains NOT_RUN

capabilities.description: Verify the installed Unreal Engine build version and editor binary presence from authoritative on-disk records.
capabilities.evidence: Build.version record plus UnrealEditor-Cmd presence; editor workflows remain RESEARCH

capabilities.description: Verify the Unity CLI version and the installed-editor inventory on this workstation.
capabilities.evidence: CLI version plus editor inventory; editor workflows remain RESEARCH until an editor is installed
